meta.name: Tom Andrieu
meta.title: Product Builder · AI Transformation
meta.description: I build products, and I help product teams fold AI into their day-to-day work. CBA.

hero.title: HEY
hero.quote: I've been coding for 8 years. My job is building products. AI didn't change that craft, it changed who can do it and how fast. From building with it, I ended up helping other teams fold it into their day-to-day work.

about.intro: I think you learn a craft <highlight>by doing it</highlight>, and you learn to transform a craft <highlight>by having done it</highlight>.
about.detail: I prefer short iterations over closed specs, pairs over committees, and tools you understand over tools you put up with. AI didn't change that preference. It just made it apply to more problems, faster.

craft.title: AI POWERED
craft.description: AI made me stack-agnostic. Language, framework or platform: I pick what fits the problem, not what I already knew.
